run_interactive_retrieval_model: run the interactive retrieval model script to interact with a pre-trained Wizard of Wikipedia dialogue retrieval model
run_wizard_transformer_ranker_interactiv: run the WizardTransformerRankerAgent in interactive mode using the full dialogue retrieval model with default parameters
setup_wizard_of_wikipedia_args: setup command-line arguments for the Wizard of Wikipedia retrieval model using setup_args and add_cmdline_args
run_parlai_interactive_loop: run the ParlAI interactive loop with the WizardTransformerRankerAgent configured for the wizard_of_wikipedia task
configure_retrieval_model_defaults: configure default parameters for the retrieval model including n_heads, ffn_size, delimiter, and n_positions
